verdict.rationale: Superpowers publishes its own marketplace repo (obra/superpowers-marketplace) that can be added with `/plugin marketplace add`. It is also listed on claude.com/plugins and ships an Antigravity Marketplace manifest, and its plugin advertises a 'Skills-search tool for discovery'. However, the evidence does not show that this search tool works before installation rather than inside the installed plugin. Browsing the listings relies largely on host marketplaces. missing for 10: documented pre-install browse/search of the individual skills catalog, evidence that the skills-search tool works before installation, any registry or leaderboard view, hands-on corroboration of discovery.
